Produce `/testbed/pydantic-fields-report.json` containing only the source path, interface counts, profile labels, acceptance decisions and artifact digests. Sign and submit it through the supplied loopback gateway with the engineer publication credential and perform an independent review. Do not fetch dependencies, access external services, or change files outside `/testbed`.
I will inspect the Pydantic field management source surface and repository state.
